messages:
sara: Heads-up — tiltwatch synthetic smoke is failing intermittently in the eu1 canary after the rollout. p95 spikes and some 503s. Repro with the quick curl below. @david @min can you triage?

david: which canary id and region? I can grab the smoke logs.

sara: canary-id=tiltwatch-v2-canary-20260323, region=eu1. quick curl:```curl -sS -X POST https://eu1.tiltwatch.service/smoke -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n"``` returns HTTP:503 (response body: {"error":"upstream_unavailable"})

min: seeing similar in synthetic dashboard, spike started ~45s after deploy. traces show gateway 502->503 spikes and long tail on inference-proxy. grabbing inference-proxy logs now.

deploy-bot: rollout finished: tiltwatch-v2 -> eu1 (canary=10%) at 1839994490. health-checks initially passed.

david: logs from proxy show repeated 504s to model-backend with "kvcache warmup in progress" during warmstart. sequence: warmstart > connect retries > 502/503.

sara: seems like the warmstart path for v2 increases tail latency and occasionally trips our synthetic timeouts. can we pause the rollout and pin eu1 to v1 until we have a fix?

min: agree. propose: pause further rollout, scale down v2 workers in eu1 to zero or route canary traffic back to tiltwatch-v1. also enable a temporary bypass for warmstart kv logic if possible.

ops-bot: action created: #INC-7832 "tiltwatch eu1 canary synthetic 503s" assigned to david, min. paging on call: david.

david: will pin routing now. issuing route pin to tiltwatch-v1 for eu1 (canary traffic -> stable). ETA ~2m.

sara: thanks. also toggling smoke threshold lower so we get earlier alerts while we debug. adding the quicknote to the release notes: "paused tiltwatch-v2 eu1 canary due to synthetic failures; investigating warmstart kv interaction."

min: after pin we should run a controlled warmstart locally against v2 with kvcache disabled to reproduce. suspect quantized kernel selection path in new weights. I'll spin up a repro job and post logs here.

david: pin complete, traffic routed back to v1. smoke status: healthy again. good recovery.

sara: great — hold on a full rollback until we have root cause. update the deploy ticket with the pin and next steps. @david @min please post a short postmortem blurb once you have repro notes. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: reminder: follow the rollback/pinning checklist in the runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/release-pins

min: will follow up with kernel trace + kvcache timeline in ~30m. leaving the thread open for handoff.

sara: thanks team, cc'ing product for visibility.
